selection: Frozen after all 18 OpenVINO development cases: 4/6 nominal live, 4/6 pushed live, 1/6 pushed frozen. Two seeds are refused by the motor geometry guard. Rigid RGB perception passes its separately frozen test at 1.938 mm p95 with 233/236 present acceptances and no absent false positives.
conditions: identical push with initial images frozen
why_four_conditions: Include unperturbed frozen-image controls to separate ordinary grasp-offset errors from the effect of the disturbance. Report all cases and a clearly labeled comparison among seeds where both unperturbed conditions pass.
workspace_and_destinations: Exactly the original declared workspace, pose generator and three destinations; retain known unsupported-goal and invalid-start refusals in the denominator.
inference_runtime: OpenVINO CPU, FP32, on this AMD PC
controller: Two confident RGB views, rigid 103 mm geometry, 0.35 exponential filter, 4 mm fixed-jaw clearance, neural Cartesian motor mapping and measured motor/encoder feedback; explicit skill phases and separate unchanged physical monitor.
no_tuning: No model, controller, confidence or physical-threshold changes after these outcomes are exposed. Preserve every outcome and all source/model hashes. Any later candidate requires a separately declared test.
scope: Finite physical coverage and paired feedback evidence only, not any-reachable-position or arbitrary-object capability.
